Build an annotation track from whatever annotation object is at hand

Source: R/tracks.R
igvAnnotationTrack.Rd

igvR's igvAnnotationTrack() built a track that held no data. Here it picks the subclass that fits annotation: a data.frame gives a DataFrameAnnotationTrack, a UCSCData a UCSCBedAnnotationTrack and any other GRanges a GRangesAnnotationTrack.

Usage

igvAnnotationTrack(trackName, annotation, ...)

Arguments

trackName

A character string, used as track label by igv

annotation

a data.frame, GRanges or UCSCData

...

further arguments of the subclass constructor, e.g. color, displayMode, trackHeight

Value

an object of a subclass of igvAnnotationTrack

Examples

tbl <- data.frame(chrom = "chr1", start = 100, end = 200,
                  stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
class(igvAnnotationTrack("demo", tbl))
#> [1] "DataFrameAnnotationTrack"
#> attr(,"package")
#> [1] "igvShiny"
